paite: Huan adingh a, huai a kipan Judia gam ah leh Jordan gal ah apaita hi. Akiang ah mipite ahong kikhawm ua; huchi in ahih ngeidan in amaute thu ahilh nawn hi.
heading: Kimak Thu A Dotna / (Mat 19.1-12; Luk 16.18)
english: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

paite: Pharisai khenkhat akiang ah ahong pai ua, amah ze-etna ding in, "Mi'n zi amak asiang hia?" chi in ahong dong uhi.
english: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Mosi in bangchi in thu ahon pia a?" chi in adawng a.
english: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”

paite: Amau, "Mosi in kimakna laigelh a mak aphal," achi uhi.
english: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na lungtang khauh ziak un ahi huai thupiak nou a dia ahon gelhsak.
english: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

paite: Himahleh leitung pian tung a kipan, Pathian in amaute numei leh pasal asiam hi.
english: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

paite: Huai thu ziak in pasal in anu leh apa apaisan ding a, azi alen tinten ding;
english: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

paite: huchi in anih un sa khat ahong hita ding ua; nih ahi nawnta kei ua, sa khat ahong hi zawta ding uh.
english: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian in agawmsa mihing in khen kei hen," achi hi.
english: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”

paite: Huan inn ah anungzuite'n huai thu amah adong nawn uhi.
english: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Kuapeuh azi ma a, midang nei in azi ang akawmsan hi;
english: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

paite: ama'n leng apasal khen a, midang aneihleh angkawm ahi," achi hi.
english: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”

paite: Mite'n akhoih ding in naupang neute ahon pi ua; huan nungzuite'n huai mite ana tai uhi.
heading: Jesu'n Naupang Neute Avualzawl / (Mat 19.13-15; Luk 18.15-17)
english: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n huai amuh in alung hi kei mahmah a, nungzuite kiang ah, "Naupang neute ka kiang ah hon paisak unla, kham kei un; Pathian lalgam hichibang mite a ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, "Kuapeuh naupang neute'n akipahpih bang a Pathian lalgam kipahpih lou asung ah alut kei hial ding,” achi hi.
english: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

paite: Huan amau pom in, atung uah akhut akoih a, avualzawlta hi.
english: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

paite: Huan pai ding a apawt lai in mi khat amah lam ah ahong tai a, ama ah akhukdin a, akiang ah, "Sinsakpa hoih, tangtawn hinna ka neihtheihna ding in bang ka hih dia?" chi in adong hi.
heading: Mihausa Leh Hauhna In Lam Akhak / (Mat 19.16-30; Luk 18,18-30)
english: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Bangziak a hoih hon chi na hia? Mi khat kia lou ngal kuamah hoih a-om kei uh, huai Pathian ahi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.

paite: Thupiakte na thei vo oi; tual that ke'n, angkawm ke'n, gu ke'n, hek ke'n, khem ke'n, na nu leh na pa zahtak in, chihte," achi hi.
english: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, huai tengteng ka naupan lai a kipan ka zuita," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”

paite: Jesu'n amah a-en a, a-it a, akiang ah, "Hih ding khat nei lai chia; pai inla, na neih peuhmah zuak inla, tagahte kiang ah pia in, huchi in van ah gou na nei ding; huan hong pai inla, hon zui in,” achi hi.
english: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”

paite: Himahleh, huai thu ah amel ahong mual a, lungkhamtak in apaimangta; mihausa ahih ziak in.
english: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

paite: Jesu'n a-en vialvial a, anungzuite kiang ah, "Mihausate ding in Pathian lalgam lut haksat tuak hi na mai e," achi hi.
english: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”

paite: Nungzuite'n athugen lamdang asa mahmah uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Naute aw, hauhna muangte a ding in Pathian lalgam a lut ahaksa ngei e.
english: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

paite: Pathian lalgam a mihausa alut sang in sangawngsau phim bilvang a lut paisuak abaihlamzaw," achi hi.
english: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Amau lamdang asa mahmah ua, akiang ah, "Ahihleh, kua hotdam ahi thei dia?" achi uhi.
english: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

paite: Jesu'n amau a-en a, "Huai zaw mihing a ding in hih vual ahi kei, Pathian a ding in bel hih vual louh a-om kei; Pathian a ding in bangkim hihtheih ahi ngal iris a," achi hi.
english: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

paite: Peter in akiang ah, "Ngai dih, kou bangkim paisan in ka hon zui ua,” chi in agen pan a.
english: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all and have followed you.”

paite: Jesu'n, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh keimah ziak leh tanchinhoih ziak a inn, unaupate, unaunute, nu, pa, tate leh gamte paisan,
english: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,

paite: tu damsung mahmah in, innte, unaupate, sanggamnute, nute, tate, gamte aleh za in, sawinate toh, hun hong tung ding a tangtawn hinna toh mu lou ding mahmah a-om kei hi.
english: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

paite: Himahleh mi tampi masapen a omte nanungpen ahong hi ding ua, nanungpente leng masapen ahong hi ding uh," achi hi.
english: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”

paite: Huan Jerusalem a hohtou ding in lampi ah a-om ua; Jesu'n ama uh akai hi. Amau lamdang asa mahmah ua; ahon zuite'n alau uhi. Ama'n sawm-le-nihte apituam nawn a, atung a tung dingte ahilh hi.
heading: Jesu'n Asih Ding Thumvei Agenkholhna / (Mat 20.17-19; Luk 18.31-34)
english: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

paite: "Ngai dih ua, Jerusalem a hohtou ding i hi ua; Mihing Tapa siampu liante leh laigelhmite khut ah matsak in a-om ding; amau si ding in atung ah thu ahihpuk ding ua, Zentelte kiang ah ape ding uh.
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.

paite: Amau nuihza bawlna in anei ding ua, chil asiatkhum ding ua, avo ding ua, athat ding uh; himahleh ni thum nung in athounawn ding," chi in atung a thil tung dingte amaute ahilh hi.
english: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

paite: Huan Zebedai tapa Jakob leh Johan in amah ahong naih ua, akiang ah, "Sinsakpa na kiang a ka hon nget peuh uh na hon hihsak ka ut uh," achi uhi.
heading: Jakob Leh Johan Ngetna / (Mat 20.20-28)
english: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou a ding in bang hon hihsak leng na ut ua?" achi hi.
english: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Na thupina ah na taklam ah khat, na veilam ah khat hon tusak in," achi uhi.
english: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na nget uh na thei kei ua ahi. Ka nou dawn ding na dawn thei ding ua hia? Ka baptisma tan ding leng na tang thei ding ua hia?" achi hi.
english: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Hihthei e,” achi uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ka nou dawn ding na dawn ding ua, ka baptisma tan ding leng na tang ding uh;
english: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

paite: himahleh ka taklam leh ka veilam a tut ding thu zaw kei piak ding ahi kei a, abawlsakte uh a ding ahi zaw,” achi hi.
english: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

paite: Huan sawmte'n huai azak un, Jakob leh Johan tung ah alungkim kei uhi.
english: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

paite: Jesu'n amau asam a, akiang uah, "Zentelte tung a vaihawm dia asehte uh atung uah alian mahmah ua, amiliante un atung uah thu anei mahmah uh chih na thei uhi.
english: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

paite: Himahleh noute lak ah zaw huchibang ahi kei ding; kuapeuh na lak ua milian hih ut nasemtu in apang zaw ding ahi.
english: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

paite: Kuapeuh na lak ua masapen hih utmi tengteng sikha a apan ding ahi.
english: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.

paite: Mihing Tapa hial leng nna sepsak a om ding in ahong pai kei a, nasem ding leh mi tampi tatna dia ahinna pe ding a hong pai ahi zaw hi," achi hi.
english: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

paite: Huan Jeriko khua ahong tung uhi; huchi in Jesu, Jeriko a kipan anungzuite leh mipi tampitak toh apawt lai un khutdoh mittaw, Timai tapa Bartimai lam gei ah ana tu hi.
heading: Mittaw Bartimai Hihdamna / (Mat 20.29-34; Luk 18,35-43)
english: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

paite: Huan Nazaret Jesu ahi chih azaktak in, "Jesu, David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in," chi in akikou hi.
english: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

paite: Mi tampi in dai ding in akhou ua; himahleh ama'n, "David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in," chi in akinak kou semsem hi.
english: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

paite: Jesu adingh a, "Amah hon sam dih ua," achi hi. Huan mittaw asam ua akiang ah, "Khamuangtak in om in. Thou in; ahon sam," achi uhi.
english: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”

paite: Huan apuan paikhia in adingh a, Jesu kiang ah ahohta hi.
english: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

paite: Jesu'n amah ahoupih a, "Na tung ah bang hon hihsak leng na ut a?" achi hi. Mittaw in akiang ah, "Heutupa, muh theih ka ut," achi hi.
english: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”

paite: Jesu'n, akiang ah, "Paita in, na ginna dampih hi teh,” achi a, huchi in amu thei pahta a, lampi ah Jesu azuita hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.
